# Real output of s6-svstat, captured from the add-on image (morse-micro-halow-ap:local, built from the
# pinned base image) with s6 2.15.1.0 (s6-overlay 3.2.3.2, aarch64, /usr/bin/s6-svstat): a
# throwaway container ran s6-svscan over a scratch service directory and s6-svstat was run
# against services in each state. Nothing here is edited except the section names.
#
# Format: "@@ <name> rc=<exit status>", the output lines, "@@ end". The tests read these
# sections instead of inventing output, so the fakes cannot drift from the real program.
# The *_o sections are `s6-svstat -o up,pid <dir>` (what the manager runs); the *_plain
# sections are `s6-svstat <dir>` (the human-readable form, which the manager does not parse).
# Note `pgid N` in the plain form of s6 2.15.1.0.
@@ up_o rc=0
true 47
@@ end
@@ up_plain rc=0
up (pid 47 pgid 47) 2 seconds
@@ end
@@ never_started_o rc=0
false -1
@@ end
@@ never_started_plain rc=0
down (not started yet)
@@ end
@@ unsupervised_early_o rc=0
false -1
@@ end
@@ unsupervised_early_plain rc=0
down (not started yet) , normally up, want up
@@ end
@@ missing_o rc=1
s6-svstat: fatal: unable to read status for /tmp/sv/nonexistent: s6-supervise not running
@@ end
@@ missing_plain rc=1
s6-svstat: fatal: unable to read status for /tmp/sv/nonexistent: s6-supervise not running
@@ end
@@ want_down_o rc=0
true 45
@@ end
@@ want_down_plain rc=0
up (pid 45 pgid 45) 5 seconds, want down
@@ end
@@ killed_o rc=0
false -1
@@ end
@@ killed_plain rc=0
down (signal SIGKILL) 1 seconds, normally up, ready 1 seconds
@@ end
@@ normally_down_up_o rc=0
true 145
@@ end
@@ normally_down_up_plain rc=0
up (pid 145 pgid 145) 1 seconds, normally down
@@ end
@@ stopped_o rc=0
false -1
@@ end
@@ stopped_plain rc=0
down (signal SIGTERM) 1 seconds, ready 1 seconds
@@ end
